en: Your spirit is strong. Let us exchange numbers, so that we may train against each other again.
Register Kenji's number in your Pokégear?
Good. I will call when my training has borne fruit.
I see. A lone path is also a path.
You have come. Take this. Training is not only for the body: your Pokémon's moves can grow too.
Ha! You're as tough as the mountain. Let's swap numbers, and I'll tell you what I find up here.
Register Parry's number in your Pokégear?
Great! I'll ring you when I've dug up something good.
No? Well, the mountain and I will be here.
There you are! Here's what I found on the mountain. It'll make your Pokémon as hard as rock!
